# BCGov Crow - v0.21.3

## Release type

Patch release: clarifies source-first reviewer challenges and strengthens
evidence checks across existing agent and skill workflows.

## Summary

Crow's review guidance now distinguishes a fresh source-first challenge from
simply assigning a different reviewer. It also makes domain-specific
verification and fallback limits more explicit without introducing a
universal oracle or reviewer requirement.

## Highlights

- Generated task prompts ask reviewers to inspect the artifact and evidence
  without preliminary conclusions, and disclose when context independence
  cannot be verified.
- Security remediation guidance records vulnerable/fixed revision outcomes
  when the same regression test can safely run against both.
- API inventory and business-rule challenges better distinguish source
  evidence from completeness or owner-intent claims.
- CI migration guidance separates mechanically comparable fields from
  provider-side permissions, checks, and execution evidence.

## Changes

- Clarified source-first review and evidence recording in security finding
  adjudication and Crow agent/skill review.
- Aligned legacy modernization's reviewer fallback with the agent workflow.
- Preserved existing domain-specific differential and regression checks.
- Updated package, plugin, collection, and README version references.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.21.3 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.21.3.zip --global --target copilot
```
